result.summary: Hessler Maschinenbau currently has one open overdue invoice of USD 640k, 52 days past due (original due 2026-10-02), on a single policy with TCI. Prior resolved overdues show lateness increasing from 9 to 19 days, and the current overdue is already far beyond that, with notification frequency rising (2 in the last 6 months vs 1 before) from the same policy. Total exposure (2.6M not-yet-due + 640k overdue) is now at ~3.24M against a 3.0M accepted credit limit, suggesting the line is effectively breached and warrants tightening or review.
concerns: Payment delays are lengthening across successive notifications (9d → 19d → 52d+ and still open)
Total exposure (3.24M) exceeds the accepted credit limit (3.0M) on policy TCI-EX-2026-0001
Notification frequency is accelerating within the 180-day window, indicating a single concentrated exposure risk with TCI
